text: The most obvious one is probably spending hours scrolling on the phone, often late at night, which affects sleep and concentration. Another is relying on fast food and energy drinks instead of proper meals, especially during exams. I'd also mention constant multitasking — lots of young people study with three apps open, and I think it makes it much harder to focus deeply on anything.

tips.en: The most obvious one … Another … I'd also mention gives three points with explanations.
tips.kk: The most obvious one … Another … I'd also mention — түсіндірмесі бар үш тармақ.
tips.ru: The most obvious one … Another … I'd also mention — три пункта с пояснениями.

tips.en: Each habit is linked to the harm it causes.
tips.ru: Каждая привычка связана с тем, чем она вредит.

questions.question: What are some common bad habits among young people today?

text: When they're young, definitely. Children copy what they see far more than what they're told, so if parents are always on their phones at dinner, telling children to put theirs away won't work very well. As kids get older, though, friends and social media start to have a much bigger influence. Teenagers often pick up habits, good and bad, from the people they want to be like.

tips.en: Copy what they see, not what they're told is a precise contrast.
tips.kk: Copy what they see … not what they're told — дәл қарама-қайшылық.
tips.ru: Copy what they see … not what they're told — точный контраст.
tips.example: Children copy what they see far more than what they're told

tips.en: As kids get older, though takes age into account.
tips.kk: As kids get older, though — жауап жасты ескереді.
tips.ru: As kids get older, though — ответ учитывает возраст.
tips.example: As kids get older, though, friends and social media start to have a much bigger influence

questions.question: Do you think children learn most of their habits from their parents?

text: I'm fairly sure they are. Most apps are specifically designed to grab our attention, with notifications, endless feeds and little rewards like likes. Our grandparents had distractions too, of course, but they weren't in their pockets all day. I've noticed it myself: I find it much harder to read a long book now than I did at fifteen, which is slightly worrying.

tips.en: Specifically designed to grab our attention shows the problem is intentional.
tips.kk: Specifically designed to grab our attention — мәселе әдейі жасалған.
tips.ru: Specifically designed to grab our attention — проблема создана намеренно.
tips.example: Most apps are specifically designed to grab our attention

tips.en: Comparing yourself now and at fifteen makes the point real.
tips.kk: Өзін қазір және он бес жаста салыстыру дәлелді жанды етеді.
tips.ru: Сравнение себя сейчас и в пятнадцать делает довод живым.
tips.example: I find it much harder to read a long book now than I did at fifteen

questions.question: Are people today more easily distracted than in the past?

text: For most people, gradually works better. If you try to change everything overnight — new diet, gym every day, no social media — you'll probably burn out within a week. Small changes are easier to stick to, and once one becomes automatic, you can add the next. That said, some people really do need a fresh start, for example after moving to a new city, when old routines are broken anyway.

tips.en: The all-at-once list shows why it fails.
tips.kk: «Бәрі бірден» тізімі мұның неге жұмыс істемейтінін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Перечень «всё сразу» показывает, почему это не работает.
tips.example: new diet, gym every day, no social media

tips.en: That said … a fresh start keeps the answer from being rigid.
tips.kk: That said … a fresh start — жауап қасаң емес.
tips.ru: That said … a fresh start — ответ не догматичный.
tips.example: some people really do need a fresh start

questions.question: Is it better to change habits gradually or all at once?

text: Probably a bit of both. Some people do seem naturally more organised from an early age. But I think it's largely a skill, like a muscle that gets stronger with practice. People who've had to juggle a job and studies, or care for a family member, often become incredibly disciplined simply because they had no choice. So environment and experience matter at least as much as personality.

tips.en: Like a muscle that gets stronger with practice is a clear comparison.
tips.kk: Like a muscle that gets stronger with practice — көрнекі салыстыру.
tips.ru: Like a muscle that gets stronger with practice — наглядное сравнение.
tips.example: like a muscle that gets stronger with practice

tips.en: Juggling work and study proves that discipline can be learned.
tips.kk: Жұмыс пен оқуды қатар алып жүру — тәртіпке үйренуге болатынының дәлелі.
tips.ru: Работа и учёба одновременно — доказательство, что дисциплине учатся.
tips.example: People who've had to juggle a job and studies
